bluf: France 24 reported that the death toll from a Russian bombing of an aid distribution point in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia region rose to 42, with dozens still missing; the bombing was on Monday. Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in jail for colluding with foreign entities, according to Al Jazeera; France 24 described the sentence as 10 more years.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: Dozens killed, dozens more missing after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that Zyxel patched a zero-day vulnerability in GS1900 network switches after attackers exploited it to compromise nearly 1,000 devices worldwide and steal configuration files and credentials; the event date is not stated.
BleepingComputer reported that CISA warned federal agencies that attackers were exploiting a recently patched WordPress vulnerability in the wild.

items.text: France 24 reported that the death toll from a Russian bombing of an aid distribution point in southeastern Zaporizhzhia rose to 42, with dozens still missing; officials said the bombing occurred on Monday.

Al Jazeera reported that the US sanctioned Indian and Turkish firms accused of helping Iran; the US Treasury said an Indian couple faked ship registries for countries including Guyana and Laos to help Iranian tankers.
Al Jazeera reported that Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in jail for colluding with foreign entities; France 24 described it as 10 more years. The event date is not stated.
